mapper.select: SELECT ar.no, ar.user_nickname as userNickname, ar.rating, ar.content, ar.create_at as createAt, ar.update_at as updateAt, ar.attraction_no as attractionNo, ar.user_no as userNo FROM attraction_review ar WHERE ar.attraction_no = #{attractionNo} ORDER BY ar.create_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page} * #{size}
